title: oddsengine.quota.warning.v1
description: Remaining upstream credits crossed below the floor (previous >= floor > now). Written once per crossing; re-armed when remaining rises back above the floor. Broadcast to every active destination. It never switches Auto-Refresh off (ADR-016). CloudEvents 1.0 structured mode (ADR-014).

remaining.description: Credits left after the observed call.

used.description: Credits used this month; null when never reported.

floor.description: The floor that was crossed: the operator's, or 10% of the plan.

observed_at.description: When the call that crossed the floor was observed.
